description: Player 2's deck for the other seat's view of R316: 08-do-nothing-b with #100 Ceaseless Void swapped for #90 CN-Viral Injection (1 mana, "Shuffle a CN-Virus into the opponent's library"). After seat 1 has filled its library to LIBRARY_CAP (25-library-full-a), seat 2 plays it on turn 2 on its own 1 mana and the full library refuses the CN-Virus, which is never created: a `libraryOverflow` for seat 1's library on seat 2's device, naming the CN-Virus (a card that copies nothing reads openly to both players, R316). The spec's seed deals it to seat 2 by turn 2. Every other card costs 3 or more and none acts from a hand or a library by itself (08-do-nothing-b), and The Coin keeps seat 2's turn from ending by itself (R82).
